facts.text: The hotel sits on the shores of Jinji Lake in Suzhou.
facts.excerpt: InterContinental Suzhou occupies a coveted location on the shores of Jinji Lake

facts.text: The hotel is a 27-storey crescent-shaped building.
facts.excerpt: The 27-storey crescent shaped hotel features 427 contemporary guestrooms

facts.text: The guestrooms, restaurants, lounges and indoor infinity pool look out over willow-fringed Jinji Lake and the new Suzhou skyline.
facts.excerpt: an indoor infinity pool – all boasting panoramic views of the willow-fringed Jinji Lake and the new Suzhou skyline

facts.text: The indoor pool on the 3rd floor has an infinity edge that appears to dip right into Jinji Lake.
facts.excerpt: With an infinity edge that appears to dip right into Jinji Lake, the 28-metre Indoor Swimming Pool is located on the 3rd floor of InterContinental Suzhou.

facts.text: The heated pool is accompanied by a large Jacuzzi, gender-separated steam and sauna rooms, a sun deck and a chill-out lounge.
facts.excerpt: The 28-metre swimming pool is accompanied by a large Jacuzzi, gender-separated steam and sauna rooms, a luxurious sun deck and a chill-out lounge.

facts.text: Sky Lounge 25 is on the balcony of Club InterContinental on the 25th floor, with panoramic views of Jinji Lake and a whisky and cocktail list.
facts.excerpt: The Sky Lounge 25 at the balcony of Club InterContinental on the 25th floor is a superb place to get some fresh air while enjoying the panoramic vista of Jinji Lake.

facts.text: XIU is the hotel's signature modern Chinese restaurant; XIU means embroidery in Mandarin, a timeless symbol of the city.
facts.excerpt: XIU, the signature modern Chinese restaurant, celebrates regional Chinese dining while adding fresh culinary presentations and a sophisticated contemporary ambience. XIU means embroidery in Mandarin, which is a timeless symbol of the city.

facts.text: Riva Mediterranean Steakhouse serves char-grilled steaks and roast seafood from a wood-fired oven.
facts.excerpt: serves up premium char-grilled steaks and roast seafood from a wood-fired oven

facts.text: The all-day dining room JING has seven island kitchens and is styled like an old Suzhou street market.
facts.excerpt: All Day Dining Room JING is characterized by seven island kitchens where top chefs create an array of global cuisines. Dishes are prepared "a la minute" and served directly by the chefs in this colourful restaurant styled like an "old Suzhou" street market.

facts.text: The hotel is within easy walking distance of Jinji Lake and many shopping and recreation areas.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is within easy walking distance to Jinji Lake and many other shopping and recreation areas.

facts.text: The Eslite Spectrum Suzhou Store, the first Eslite flagship in Mainland China, is one step away from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: It is the first flagship store in Mainland China, only one step away from InterContinental Suzhou.

facts.text: Humble Administrator's Garden is about 10 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Humble Administrator’s Garden - 6.21 miles away (10 kilometers)

facts.text: The Suzhou Museum, nearby, was designed by architect I.M. Pei.
facts.excerpt: Designed by renowed architect I.M. Pei, It has more than 15,000 historic artifacts in its collections

facts.text: The hotel has extensive meeting, conference and event facilities.
facts.excerpt: For MICE events, InterContinental Suzhou offers extensive meetings, conference and event facilities.

facts.text: Children's activities are offered on site.
Wuxi Sunan International Airport is about 44 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: approximately 27.28 miles away (43.9 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: Riva is described as the only western restaurant in Suzhou rewarded by Black Pearl.
facts.excerpt: also the only western restaurant in Suzhou rewarded by Black Pearl

facts.text: Public transport nearby includes Suzhou Yuanqu Station and Times Square Station.
